title: Mission Video Questions
intro: Choose questions that fit the class discussion; there is no need to use them all.

items: What is the name of the school?
What clues tell us this isn't an ordinary school?
What words would you use to describe the atmosphere?
What do you think students learn at Confetti Cake Cottage?
The sign says, ‘Where every celebration hides a little chaos.’ What do you think that means?
Based on the video, what clues do you think might become important later in the story?
